name: LR-027 s3: the claim is unconditional, so two runs both send
old:
WHERE id = %s AND state IN ('pending', 'not_sent')
                         AND claimed_at IS NULL AND attempts < %s

name: LR-027 s3: an uncertain email is treated as unsent and retried
old: return UNKNOWN, None, f"unknown_{attempt.status_code}" if attempt.status_code else "unknown"

name: LR-027 s3: an abandoned claim is reopened instead of marked unknown
new: SET state = 'not_sent', claimed_at = NULL, outcome_at = now(), last_error_class = 'abandoned'

name: LR-027 s3: a known-unsent outcome keeps its claim, so it is never retried
old: claimed_at = CASE WHEN %s = 'not_sent' THEN NULL ELSE claimed_at END
new: claimed_at = CASE WHEN %s = 'never' THEN NULL ELSE claimed_at END

name: LR-027 s3: the OPS_ALERTS_ENABLED switch is ignored
LR-027 s3: a flapping re-open texts again
LR-027 s3: member updates are texted
old: wants_sms = (sms_key and configured["sms"] and not event.startswith("update:")

name: LR-027 s3: the send log line carries the destination
old:
logger.warning("OPS_ALERT_SEND row=%s channel=%s event=%s outcome=%s class=%s",
                   row_id,
new:
logger.warning("OPS_ALERT_SEND to=%s row=%s channel=%s event=%s outcome=%s class=%s",
                   _sms_to() or _email_to(), row_id,

name: LR-027 s3: a Twilio 4xx refusal is treated as uncertain (never retried)
old: return NOT_SENT, None, f"refused_{status}"      # Twilio answered: no message created

name: LR-027 s3: renotify fires before six hours
Codex #327 P1: retries consume no capacity (rows counted, not attempts)
Codex #327 P1: refused attempts (claim released) are not counted
old:
WHERE channel = 'sms' AND event NOT LIKE 'sms\\_cap:%'
                     AND GREATEST(claimed_at, outcome_at) > now() - interval '1 hour'
new:
WHERE channel = 'sms' AND event NOT LIKE 'sms\\_cap:%'
                     AND claimed_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
